description: Source file implementing a helper class for matrix operations, including creation, transformation, inversion, and multiplication of 4x4 matrices, along with related vector transformations.

classes.name: Matrix4
classes.description: A class representing a 4x4 matrix with various static and member functions for matrix operations.

methods.name: Matrix4()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the matrix as an identity matrix.

methods.name: Matrix4(float m00, float m01, float m02, float m03, float m10, float m11, float m12, float m13, float m20, float m21, float m22, float m23, float m30, float m31, float m32, float m33)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matrix with specified elements.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Creates a rotation matrix around a given vector by a specified angle.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Creates a translation matrix for a given vector.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Creates a scaling matrix for a given vector.

methods.name: frustum
methods.description: Creates a frustum projection matrix with specified bounds.

methods.name: perspective
methods.description: Creates a perspective projection matrix based on field of view and aspect ratio.

methods.name: rollPitchYaw
methods.description: Creates a combined rotation matrix from roll, pitch, and yaw angles.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a given matrix.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of a matrix.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a Vector3 or Vector4 using the matrix.
